items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: afterwards, became a wonderfully close friend

ctx.x: Even if you weren't too familiar with him, because he was truly one of the great musicians of our era, and our era really covers a lot, you know? We're talking about the early thirties and twenties, to today -- '79.

afterwards, became a wonderfully close friend, and his contribution to the band was an amazing thing because Billy was an arranger -- he was arranging all over New York, with the big shows, the Hit Parade and other shows at that time, record dates and so forth -- and he was busy arranging. And it was always on the tip of all musician's tongues that they could never understand how Billy sounded and played so great, because to anybody's knowledge, he was never playing around at any jazz joints, where his lip came…
